name: JOHN_THE_APOSTLE
canonical: John the apostle, the youngest disciple, a Galilean fisherman of about thirty, smooth olive skin, a soft only-lightly-bearded gentle face, dark wavy shoulder-length hair, earnest tender eyes, in a simple homespun cream tunic and mantle — the beloved disciple who stood at the cross
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
